## Definition
A reservoir computing architecture built on Neural Cellular Automata, where local update rules process spatiotemporal signals in a distributed grid. Provides a scalable, locally-interacting substrate for in-network neuromorphic computation, aligning with TCC's topology-centric processing paradigm.
